headline: Hold at 8 of 8
paragraph: Welcome to the Quant Flow Capital briefing covering eight major central banks meeting this month. At this point, all eight institutions are widely projected to keep their current interest rates steady as policymakers review recent economic data. Among the group, the Swiss National Bank stands out by maintaining a rate of zero percent while others range between 1.25 percent and 4.85 percent.

countries.why: The RBA raised rates to 4.85% on Nov 3; we expect a pause at the December meeting.
